API for caching, loading, and invalidating Solana on-chain programs.

# Purpose
This header defines the public API for `fd_progcache`, which manages a cache of loaded Solana on-chain programs. It describes how the cache handles fork-aware state, lazy fills on reads, eager invalidation on writes, and eviction when memory allocation fails during a fill. The file also defines the `fd_progcache_t` state object, cache metrics in `fd_progcache_metrics_t`, and the main operations [`fd_progcache_peek`](<#fd_progcache_peek>), [`fd_progcache_pull`](<#fd_progcache_pull>), and [`fd_progcache_invalidate`](<#fd_progcache_invalidate>). It is used by the runtime to reduce repeated program loading and verification work while preserving correct behavior across forks and slot changes.

- `fd_progcache_join`
- `fd_progcache_leave`
- `fd_progcache_peek`
